paper_title: ADMX SLIC: Results from a Superconducting LC Circuit Investigating Cold Axions
notes: Paper is the ADMX SLIC pilot haloscope (LC circuit) axion dark matter search. It clearly presents new measured exclusion limits on the axion-photon coupling g_agamma in three narrow mass bands (1.7498-1.7519e-7 eV at 4.5 T, 1.7734-1.7738e-7 eV at 5.0 T, 1.8007-1.8015e-7 eV at 7.0 T). Numerical limit values are only shown in Figure 4 (not machine-readable here); the abstract states exclusions 'for coupling below 1e-12 GeV^-1', so a flat ~1e-12 GeV^-1 level is used across each band as an approximation - actual RFI-limited limit curves vary within each band. DM density not explicitly stated in the excerpt; 0.45 GeV/cm^3 is the standard ADMX assumption. Confidence level not explicitly stated; 90% assumed per ADMX convention. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.6, 6))
